verdict.rationale: Elicit supports live collaboration in Research Agent sessions, where invited team members with edit access can ask questions and produce/edit artifacts, and reports/tables can be exported (PDF, Word, CSV, etc.) for sharing outside the platform. However, there's no evidence of granular view-only vs. edit permission controls, shareable links, comments/annotations, or Systematic Review-level collaboration beyond the Research Agent session. missing for 10: view-only sharing/permission controls, shareable link generation, commenting/annotation features, evidence of collaboration on Systematic Review workflows specifically, independent/hands-on corroboration of the collaboration feature.
